title: ID0419945-DC/Si-D/NZ-[Y2 / R3 313057296006]- FC14 flash red
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:  Charger was powered down to investigate a locked gun issue.
When power was restored the charger did not come back online.
FC14 has tripped again and is flashing red. Our tech Glen is onsite
to investigate.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0419945-DC/Si-D/NZ-[Y2 / R3 313057296006] locked gun issue CRM:01282000950
additional_info.body:
Hey Liz,
Well done on the repair.
Just wanted to inform you that this case will now be closed.
Problem Description:
FC14 Red and tripping
Resolution:
Isolated parts of the downstream circuit to isolate/identify the faulty item. fault goes away when XD21 is removed from the circuit
